1.web: David made him houses in the city of David; and he prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
1.asv: AndDavidmade him houses in the city of David; and he prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.

2.web: Then David said, “No one ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites. For Yahweh has chosen them to carry the ark of God, and to minister to him forever.”
2.asv: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath Jehovah chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.

3.web: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up Yahweh’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.
3.asv: And David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Jehovah unto its place, which he had prepared for it.

4.web: David gathered together the sons of Aaron, and the Levites:
4.asv: And David gathered together the sons of Aaron, and the Levites:

5.web: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;
5.asv: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brethren a hundred and twenty;

6.web: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;
6.asv: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty;

7.web: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers one hundred thirty;
7.asv: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brethren a hundred and thirty;

8.web: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred;
8.asv: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred;

9.web: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers eighty;
9.asv: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore;

10.web: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.
10.asv: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brethren a hundred and twelve.

11.web: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
11.asv: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,

12.web: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring up the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel, to the place that I have prepared for it.
12.asv: and said unto them, Ye are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of Jehovah, the God of Israel, unto the place that I have prepared for it.

13.web: For because you didn’t carry it at first, Yahweh our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”
13.asv: For because ye bare it not at the first, Jehovah our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not according to the ordinance.

14.web: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel.
14.asv: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of Jehovah, the God of Israel.

15.web: The children of the Levites bore the ark of God on their shoulders with the its poles, as Moses commanded according to Yahweh’s word.
15.asv: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of Jehovah.

16.web: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers the singers, with instruments of music, stringed instruments and harps and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up the voice with joy.
16.asv: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren the singers, with instruments of music, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up the voice with joy.

17.web: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
17.asv: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

18.web: and with them their brothers of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Eliphelehu, and Mikneiah, and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.
18.asv: and with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Eliphelehu, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.

19.web: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of brass to sound aloud;
19.asv: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed, with cymbals of brass to sound aloud;

20.web: and Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth;
20.asv: and Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries set to Alamoth;

21.web: and Mattithiah, and Eliphelehu, and Mikneiah, and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.
21.asv: and Mattithiah, and Eliphelehu, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps set to the Sheminith, to lead.

22.web: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the song: he instructed about the song, because he was skillful.
22.asv: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.

23.web: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
23.asv: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

24.web: Shebaniah, and Joshaphat, and Nethanel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
24.asv: And Shebaniah, and Joshaphat, and Nethanel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow the trumpets before the ark of God; and Obed-edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

25.web: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of Yahweh out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
25.asv: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.

26.web: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
26.asv: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, that they sacrificed seven bullocks and seven rams.

27.web: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites who bore the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: and David had on him an ephod of linen.
27.asv: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: and David had upon him an ephod of linen.

28.web: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of Yahweh with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.
28.asv: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with psalteries and harps.

29.web: As the ark of the covenant of Yahweh came to the city of David, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.
29.asv: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of Jehovah came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.
